sloka: ततह् प्रियान् प्राप्य मनोभिरामान् ।सुप्रीतियुक्ताः सुमनोभिरामाः ।गृहेषु हृष्टाः परमाभिरामाः ।हरिप्रवीरः स ददर्श रामाः ॥५-५-२१॥
transliteration: tatah priyān prāpya manobhirāmān ।suprītiyuktāḥ sumanobhirāmāḥ ।gṛheṣu hṛṣṭāḥ paramābhirāmāḥ ।haripravīraḥ sa dadarśa rāmāḥ ॥5-5-21॥

translations.english: That heroic monkey saw ogresses delighted in the happy company of their loved ones who have joined them, ecstatic wives in the houses.
